exposure: Place of labor (free-standing birth center vs. hospital maternity unit)
cohort: 47,381 women with low-risk pregnancies who gave birth in South Auckland maternity facilities between 2003 and 2010
finding: Labor in free-standing birth centers was associated with lower rates of interventions (instrumental delivery, cesarean section, blood transfusion) and comparable perinatal outcomes compared to labor in a hospital maternity unit.
